overview: Work this week centers on learned representations and surrogates: contrastive ASTROMER 2 for light curves, neural operators for MHD turbulence and rotating stars, and physics-informed solar-wind and flare models. Cosmology papers apply simulation-based inference to DES Y3 shear and normalizing flows to DESI DR1 N(z). New benchmarks include COSMIO for LSST/Euclid/Roman cross-survey imputation and agentic survey decision-making.
themes: Neural surrogates and physics-informed models for simulation
Simulation-based inference and cosmological parameter estimation
LLM agents for survey operations and high-energy workflows
